Hon 'b le Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J
1. Mr. Devesh Upreti, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned
Additional C.S.C. for the State of
Uttarakhand.
3. Petitioner was appointed as Teacher
in a Governm ent Aided School and he
retired from the post of Assistant Teacher
- L.T. Grade (Biology) on 31.05.2023.
According to him , he was not paid any
am ount as Pension or Gratuity.
4. By m eans of this writ petition,
petitioner has sought the following
reliefs: -
(i) I ssue a writ, order or direction in the nature
of Mandam us Com manding the respondent
no. 3 to give the benefit of order dated
07.12.2018 (Annexure No. 14), passed by
this Hon'ble Court in WPSS No. 524/ 2024
(S/ S), so far as it relates to quashing of
order dated 27.06.2013 (passed by
respondent no. 3) and accordingly, enter the
date of regularization of petitioner as
27.01.2005 in the service book of petitioner.
(ii) I ssue a writ order or direction of Mandamus
commanding the respondent no. 1 to 4 to
give the benefits of Old Pension Scheme to
the petitioner from the date of his
retirement (31.05.2023), counting his
services from 01.02.1993 by treating the
date of regularization of services of
petitioner w.e.f. 27.01.2005.
(iii) I ssue a writ, order or direction in the nature
of Certiorari by quashing the Order/ Letter
No. 06/ Asha. Maa./ 7527-29/ 2023-24, dated

2025:UHC:9802
07.11.2024 (Annexure No. 19), issued by
respondent no. 4, so far it relates to
preparation of documents of petitioner for
granting him the benefit of new pension
scheme.
5. Learned State Counsel was asked to
get instructions in the m atter, as to
whether petitioner's case is covered by
judgment dated 07.12.2018 rendered in
WPSS No. 524 of 2014.
6. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned
State Counsel has produced in Court
written instructions received by him from
the Office of Additional Director of
Education, Pauri, which is taken on
record. The same shall be paginated by
the Registry.
7. Based on written instructions,
learned State Counsel submits that
petitioner's case is covered by judgment
dated 07.12.2018 rendered in WPSS No.
524 of 2014, therefore, he has no
objection if writ petition is decided in
term s of the said judgment.
8. I n view of concession recorded by
learned State Counsel, the writ petition is
decided in term s of judgment dated
07.12.2018 rendered in WPSS No. 524 of
2014.
 ( Man oj Ku m ar Tiw ar i, J)
